sealed_windows.note: w0-w2 all DON'T SHIP; holdout ECE declined in w0 and w1

rationale: Member gate fails (5 of 6 conditions): the winner overfits under production fit semantics (50 flat rounds) — pooled logloss/AUC/ECE all worse, and sealed ECE degrades 0.0423 -> 0.0526 (calibration priority). Blend gate also fails: pooled blend AUC -0.003, ECE +0.0091, member ECE worse. The tuner's promising pooled number (0.67594) is an artifact of its early-stopped trial loop (median 14 rounds) which production does not use. REJECTED; config.LIGHTGBM_PARAMS stays. A deployable LGB re-tune would need to search rounds under production fit semantics (or production must adopt per-fold early stopping — out of scope for the tuning gate).
